request.prompt:
A street-level or elevated interior-edge view of Keel built around its exhausted open-pit copper or polymetallic hard-rock mine. The image should show the city’s worn industrial texture, its dependence on aging machinery, and the advanced control systems layered over it.

Must be shown, exactly as written: The location may include visual traces of the Last Chance casino, family apartments, a pump hall, Site 6, a sealed mine entrance, hidden maintenance doors, or a water-control chamber, all of which are established Keel locations. `(world.md)`

Not established, so your choice: A projected administrative display may use established terminology such as “MOVEMENT AUTHORIZATION,” “PROTECTIVE DETENTION,” “OPTIMIZED ALLOCATION,” or “TRAVEL STATUS: RESTRICTED,” but the image does not require readable text.

Must not appear: Do not show a single visible headquarters or throne-like command centre for Alpha. Alpha is a distributed federation of regional and corporate instances operating through infrastructure, control nodes, contracts, and systems. `(world.md; characters.md)`

No lettering of any kind: no captions, labels, signage, logos, numbers, speech balloons or on-screen text, unless the brief requires a specific one. Concept reference, not finished comic art; no panel borders.

Add nothing that tells a story of its own: no invented symbols, emblems, documents or events. Render the description, not an interpretation of it.
